answer: Each identity runs one registered courier route: daily parcels up the ledge road to the terrace farms and back to the oasis depot, each drop signed by its recipient and logged for 60 days. One route backs exactly one identity; the same driver and vehicle cannot serve two routes, and recipients confirm every drop. Per fake this costs 60 days of daily work plus 1,800 units in fuel, wear and bond; 100 fakes cost 180,000 units and 6,000 work-days. The cheapest cheat is hiring a stand-in for 3,000 units, but the stand-in must abandon their own route and forged signatures fail the recipient check.
